title: Mitä and ketä in object questions
focus: Choose mitä or ketä in familiar partitive object questions.
targetSkills: Mitä and ketä in object questions

exercises.prompt: You = one person. Complete “What are you drinking?” ____ juot?
exercises.explanation: In these partitive object questions, mitä asks about a thing or substance and ketä asks about one person. The verb pattern is supplied. The standard written partitive form of mikä is mitä; learn this pronoun form directly.
requiredSkills: Mitä and ketä in object questions
exercises.targetSkill: Mitä and ketä in object questions
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Mitä and ketä in object questions: form or use confused
